Package org.apache.sis.gui.map

package org.apache.sis.gui.map
Widgets for showing a map in a JavaFX application. Map­Canvas is the base class for painting a map using arbitrary JavaFX nodes such as Image­View or Canvas. Map­Canvas­AWT is a specialization for painting the map using Java2D.
